people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: You will fall by the sword. I will judge you in the border of Israel. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.
translations.bsb: You will fall by the sword, and I will judge you even to the borders of Israel. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
translations.kjv: Ye shall fall by the sword; I will judge you in the border of Israel; and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
translations.asv: Ye shall fall by the sword; I will judge you in the border of Israel; and ye shall know that I am Jehovah.
